custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by display name or hash. Uses deal field definitions.

expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in YYYY-MM-DD format

id.description: UUID of the lead to update (required)

organization_id.description: ID of the organization associated with this lead (null to clear)

owner_id.description: ID of the user who will own this lead

person_id.description: ID of the person associated with this lead (null to clear)

value.description: Lead value with amount and currency (null to clear)

name: leads_update
